nodes.label: PDCT Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Config-driven, scriptable, CLI-only pipeline replacing ad-hoc notebooks and the DLC GUI, which are neither reproducible nor batchable. Has no PySpin dependency and never touches camera hardware.

nodes.label: y(t) — Trustworthy Scaled Vertical Position Series
nodes.rationale: The pipeline's actual product. Descent time is a trivial query against y(t); the height-resolved velocity profile is the novel measurement and cannot be obtained any other way, so every stage is designed to serve y(t) accuracy.

nodes.label: Stage 0 · build_manifest
nodes.rationale: Reads session_metadata.json and trials.csv from archive session dirs into manifest.parquet, one row per trial × view. This manifest is the spine — every later stage queries it rather than crawling the filesystem.

nodes.label: Stage 1 · qc_gate
nodes.rationale: Adds included (bool) and exclusion_reason from config-driven rules (experimenter flags non-empty, dropped-frame rate, implausible duration, achieved_fps deviation). Never drops rows, so exclusions stay auditable and reversible.

nodes.label: Stage 2 · calibration
nodes.rationale: Intrinsics only — camera matrix and distortion coefficients per camera_serial and calibration epoch, valid until the camera is moved or refocused. Pixel→mm scale is derived per-video from pole landmarks at the kinematics stage, not here. A trial with no valid epoch is a QC failure, not a silent pass.

nodes.label: Stage 3 · extract_frames
nodes.rationale: Stratified across animal × date × session so no single animal or lighting condition dominates, with a motion/ROI prefilter before k-means because blind k-means wastes labelling budget on uninformative and occluded frames. Frame provenance back to source trial is mandatory so a bad label is traceable.

nodes.label: Stage 4 · labeling (manual)
nodes.rationale: Keypoint scheme lives in config as single source of truth and must include static pole landmarks. Label snout, mid-back/centroid and tail base so primary_keypoint can be compared without re-labelling. Never trim a SuperAnimal keypoint set to a subset — fine-tuning to a reduced subset behaves unexpectedly.

nodes.label: Stage 5 · train
nodes.rationale: SuperAnimal initialisation; Quadruped is the expected init for lateral views because subjects are rats, while TopViewMouse is mouse-trained so top-down init must be decided by zero-shot comparison rather than assumption.

nodes.label: Stage 6 · evaluate
nodes.rationale: Per-keypoint error matters because static pole landmarks should be near-zero — high error there means the coordinate frame itself is unreliable. Acts as a gate: batch inference must not run if error exceeds the config threshold.

nodes.label: Stage 7 · infer
nodes.rationale: The only stage that needs raw video: pull from archive to local cache, analyze_videos, write pose .h5, verify, delete the local copy. Resumable by skipping trials whose pose exists with matching snapshot ID and config hash. This is the pipeline bottleneck, so per-trial throughput is logged.

nodes.label: Stage 8 · kinematics
nodes.rationale: Order matters: likelihood filter → gap interpolation (gaps longer than max_gap_frames stay NaN, never silently bridged) → smoothing → undistort coordinates → pole coordinate frame from landmarks → height normalisation → mm scaling. Pole landmark drift mid-trial means the camera was bumped and flags the trial.

nodes.label: Stage 9 · report
nodes.rationale: Group-level aggregation, statistics and figures reading only trial_summary.parquet and kinematics_long.parquet — a clean, testable input contract, but in tension with what 'group-level' implies since neither file carries animal_id or project_name.

nodes.label: Future · triangulate (Anipose 3D)
nodes.rationale: Inserts between stages 7 and 8. Schemas are designed view-tagged and long-format now so this is an inserted stage rather than a rewrite. Do not build yet.

nodes.label: Trial UID — Primary Join Key
nodes.rationale: Stable deterministic string keying trial+view, used as the join key everywhere. Its compound form {animal_id}_{project_name}_{date}_{initials}_{view}_t{NNN} is not safely reversible because component fields can contain underscores.

nodes.label: Invariant 2 — Undistort Coordinates, Never Video
nodes.rationale: Re-encoding video to undistort is lossy, slow, and destroys the archive's write-once property; calibration is applied to pose output post-hoc instead. Lens distortion correction is mandatory because anything distorting apparent velocity as a function of height is a first-order threat to the hypothesis.

nodes.label: Invariant 3 — QC Marks, Never Deletes
nodes.rationale: Excluded trials stay in the manifest with an included boolean and exclusion_reason so exclusions are auditable and reversible.

nodes.label: Invariant 5 — Every Artifact Carries Provenance
nodes.rationale: A .provenance.json sidecar records input artifact hashes, config hash, code commit, DLC snapshot ID, stage version and timestamp — which is also what makes invariant 4's skip-when-hashes-match idempotency possible.

nodes.label: Invariant 12 — Analysis fps Decoupled from Acquisition fps
nodes.rationale: Any temporal downsampling is an explicit, logged config choice; conflating the two would let a downsampling setting silently corrupt capture-rate QC.

nodes.label: Archive / Cache / Derived Data Tiering
nodes.rationale: Video is huge and everything derived from it is small, and inference is the only stage needing raw video — so CRSP is a write-once archive, the local cache is transient and sized for one batch, and derived artifacts are versioned. Nothing downstream of inference requires CRSP or a GPU.

nodes.label: RTX 5070 Ti / Blackwell sm_120 cu128 Requirement
nodes.rationale: PyTorch 2.6 has no Blackwell kernels and will fail or fall back silently, so torch must come from the cu128 index-URL wheel. The CUDA version nvidia-smi reports is the driver ceiling, not what PyTorch uses — verify with torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0) expecting (12, 0).

nodes.label: Single-Camera Kinematics Are Provisional
nodes.rationale: Rats spiral around the pole, so with one lateral camera the animal is occluded behind the pole for a meaningful fraction of every trial. Also, snout, centroid and tail base are separated along the height axis, so keypoint choice changes the shape of the velocity profile rather than adding a constant offset.

nodes.label: Open Experimental-Design Decisions
nodes.rationale: SuperAnimal zero-shot comparison, primary_keypoint choice, descent onset/offset rule parameters, QC thresholds and filter windows, cu128 verification — recorded rather than resolved unattended because they are experimental-design choices, and primary_keypoint criteria must be fixed before looking at group differences.
